question: Online channel

question: Does the LMS workflow implement the 2025 Act (forms, notifications, rules)?
finding: UNKNOWN - DSB acts page now lists Boilers Act 2025, Boiler Attendants Rules 2025 and BOE Rules 2025 alongside IBR 1950 / MH Boiler Rules 1962 (SRC-141); Labour Dept DSB page still lists Boilers Act 1923 (SRC-186); online services page cites only MRTPS Act 2015 (SRC-187). No evidence that LMS forms implement the 2025 Act -> PORTAL_LEGACY / WORKFLOW_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED. Portal is NOT concluded to be legally invalid.
